_about: Public-domain John Codman (1782-1847), orthodox Congregational minister of the Second Church, Dorchester, for the Word Hoard: Hymns for Family Worship, The Importance of Spiritual Knowledge, The Faith of the Pilgrims, Sermons delivered on Various Occasions, The Hidden Life of a Christian, Duty of American Christians to send the Gospel to the Heathen, A Narrative of a Visit to England, and Review of the Past. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 97 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

codman-family-hymns: Hymns for family worship : with prayers for every day in the week (Boston : Samuel T. Johnson, 1813)
codman-spiritual-knowledge: The importance of spiritual knowledge : a sermon delivered before the Society for Propagating the Gospel among the Indians and Others in North America, in the First Church, Boston, November 3, 1825 / by John Codman ; with the report of the Select Committee (From the University Press--Hilliard and Metcalf, 1825)
codman-faith-of-pilgrims: The faith of the Pilgrims; a sermon delivered at Plymouth on the twenty-second of December, 1831 (Boston, Perkins & Marvin, 1832)
codman-sermons: Sermons delivered on various occasions, : with addresses (Boston : Perkins, Marvin, & Co., 1834)
codman-hidden-life: The Hidden Life of a Christian: Exemplified in the Character and Writings of Mrs. Susannah H (Perkins, Marcin, & Co., 1835)
codman-duty-heathen: Duty of American Christians to send the Gospel to the heathen : a sermon preached at Hartford, Sept. 14, 1836, before the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions, at their twenty-seventy annual meeting (Printed by Crocker and Brewster, 1836)
codman-visit-to-england: A narrative of a visit to England (Boston, Perkins & Marvin: Philadelphia, H. Perkins, 1836)
codman-review-of-past: Review of the past : a sermon, delivered in Dorchester, December 7, 1845, being the thirty-seventh anniversary of the author's ordination (Boston : Press of T.R. Marvin, 1846)

_excluded.codman-others: Books by later John Codmans (Sailors' Life, Ten Months in Brazil, The Mormon Country, free-ship pamphlets): a different man
